_doc: Feasibility measurement for an `exec:` evidence form in the claims ledger (road-to-enforcement-proof Phase 5). The question this answers is NOT 'would exec: be nice' but 'would it cover enough of the ledger to earn its maintenance surface'. The threshold was pre-registered in the roadmap BEFORE this was measured: >= 10 percentage points of the backed ledger, or it gets parked with the number published. Measured 2026-07-25 against docs/CLAIMS.md.
measured_at: 2026-07-25 (re-counted three times. The first publication said 25 backed / 10 feasible and was measured mid-PR. The 11-feasible figure was then corrected DOWN to 10 when the form was actually built: context-token-reduction was counted feasible because check_token_regression re-derives token figures via js-tiktoken, but the script reads internal/bench/reports/projection-cost.json, which is gitignored as a per-run artifact — so the command is not self-sufficient in a fresh checkout and exits 1. Found by the exec: gate on its first CI run, which is the gate doing its job. The backed_claims DENOMINATOR drifted separately and is now derived and gate-checked rather than retyped. Re-derived 2026-07-27: +3 backed entries from road-to-credible-install (install-audit-clean exec-backed, hook-dispatch-latency, default-install-context-cost). Re-derived 2026-07-28: +1 backed entry (code-graph-retrieval-null — bench needs local target repos, not exec:-feasible in a fresh CI checkout; stays on its pointer form). Re-derived 2026-07-29: +2 backed entries from road-to-runtime-encoding-hardening (encoding-floor-text-layer-only and encoding-corpus-scope-guard). Both stay on pointer form rather than exec:, because the measurement report's latency figure is machine-dependent and an exec: gate on it could redden on a loaded runner — the exit code would stop being a property of the code. Re-derived 2026-08-02: +1 backed entry (scope-dedup-cold-start-reduction — the 38.0% figure entered the ledger with its unreachable-in-production condition bound into the claim text, road-to-release-shape-honesty Phase 3; pointer form, since the evidence is a written honest-null record rather than a re-runnable command). Re-derived 2026-08-02 (second sitting): +4 backed entries from road-to-governance-invariants Phase 4 (governance-aggregation-refusal-invariance, governance-decomposition-effect-boundary, governance-marker-preservation-null, governance-adjacent-properties). All four stay on pointer form rather than exec:, because their numbers are re-derived by a committed vitest drift gate (tests/scripts/governance_invariants_report.test.ts) that already runs in the node-tests job — an exec: pointer would re-run the same assertions a second time for no added signal. `delta_pp` is left at its 2026-07-25 value on purpose: it records THAT measurement's verdict, not a running ratio. Re-derived 2026-08-03: +2 backed entries from the PR-#1133 external-review follow-up (keyword-anchoring-census — census claim now carries the corpus-co-edit disclosure plus an independent 49-prompt replay record; budget-routing-relation — deliberately worded to what the code proves: relation implemented + tested with the full reserve lifecycle, delivery agent-adherent and doctor-monitored, NOT 'shipped'). Both pointer form: the census evidence is a written measurement record, and the relation's numbers are re-derived by the vitest suite already in the node-tests job. Re-derived 2026-08-10: +1 backed entry (conformance-advisory-vs-blocking — the round-5 advisory-vs-blocking result, 555 → 19 vs 8 → 0 and 1 → 0; pointer form, since the numbers rest on a one-off transcript audit over the maintainer's local session store that no CI job can re-derive). Re-derived 2026-08-11: +6 backed entries from road-to-inbox-harvest-2026-08-b-authoring-contract Phase 4 — the six external research citations a normative sentence in src/ rests on (judge-family-llm-as-a-judge-foundation, adversarial-review-tree-of-thoughts, autonomous-analysis-self-refine, bug-analyzer-chain-of-verification, sequential-thinking-chain-of-thought, skill-improvement-reflexion). All six use pointer grammar #3 (external URL + dated stamp), which is NOT exec:-feasible by construction: the grammar is an existence-and-date check the tooling never dereferences, so a withdrawn or renumbered paper stays green — the reason only load-bearing cites were bound and the 14 ids appearing solely in roadmap prose were left unbound. Re-derived 2026-08-19: +1 backed entry (council-fallback-loses-zero-seats, road-to-council-api-fallback Phase 4). It is exec: form — the end-to-end suite re-derives the whole chain from a config file to a rendered artefact — but `exec_feasible` is NOT bumped, for the same reason `delta_pp` is frozen: both record the 2026-07-25 CLASSIFICATION pass, not a running tally, and only `backed_claims` is mechanically checked against the live ledger. Re-derived 2026-08-23: +3 backed entries from road-to-skill-link-integrity-and-manifest-sync (skill-link-census, adapter-lifecycle-day-one-table, augment-manifest-version-package-synced). Both pointer form: the census row is regenerated by `lint_handoffs --census-json` and the lifecycle pair is re-derived by the parity pass already wired into lint_media_policy_linkage, so an exec: pointer would re-run an assertion CI already makes. Re-derived 2026-08-23 (drain merge): +1 backed entry (council-parse-outcome-corpus-rate) from road-to-council-evidence-integrity — exec: form, re-derived by tests/scripts/ai_council/parse_corpus.test.ts in the node-tests job.
decision: JUSTIFIED — 38.5 pp clears the pre-registered 10 pp bar by a wide margin. `exec:` becomes its own PR; it is deliberately NOT built here, because the point of measuring first was to avoid shipping a schema change, a validator, and a renderer on an assumption.
method: Each backed entry was classified by whether a deterministic command could re-derive the claim with its exit code carrying the verdict. Pointing at a producer is not sufficient — a bench report whose regeneration needs paid model calls is not re-runnable in CI, and was counted NO. Two borderline cases were checked rather than assumed: measure_lexical_ranking.ts has zero model/API/fetch references (deterministic, model-free re-ranking), and token-baseline figures are re-derived by check_token_regression.ts via js-tiktoken. Both counted YES.

feasible.why: ratchet script; exit code IS the verdict
the same script re-derives the count the JSON snapshots
gate compares prose counts against source counts
ratchet built in Phase 1 of this roadmap
deterministic scan over the shipped tree
verified model-free — deterministic re-ranking of a fixed retrieved set
exact tokenizer over static surfaces; the headline token figures are re-derivable (the paired quality gate half is not, and is not claimed)
the pointer is a test assertion whose literal IS the count; running it re-derives the claim, and lint_surface_matrix independently holds the matrix in set-equality with the installer path map

honest_caveat: `exec_feasible` counts claims for which a re-running command PLAUSIBLY carries the verdict. It is not a promise that all ten pass on first wiring, and a claim whose command exits 0 for a reason unrelated to the claim would be a false green — argument hardening and a narrow prefix allowlist are what keep that from becoming the new hole.
ledger_hygiene_note: Found while counting: 10 entries filed under `## Unbacked inventory (documented debt)` carry `status: backed`. The checker keys on the status field, not the heading, so nothing is mis-gated — but the section headings no longer describe their contents and a reader would be misled. Filed for a follow-up pass, not silently fixed here.
_snapshot_note: backed_claims is checked against the live ledger by check_claims — a divergence FAILS. It drifted twice while hand-written (25 when the ledger held 26, 26 when it held 27) and CI stayed green both times because the evidence pointer resolved. The feasibility CLASSIFICATION stays a human judgment; only the denominator is mechanical.

built.note: The pre-registered threshold was >= 10 pp. Measured 38.5 pp after correction, so the decision to build stands on the corrected number too — the over-count did not change the verdict, only the size of the margin.

over_counted.actual: NO — check_token_regression requires internal/bench/reports/projection-cost.json, which is gitignored and produced by `task audit-tokens`; a command with an uncommitted precondition cannot carry exec: standalone.
over_counted.disposition: reverted to its pointer form; listed as unfalsifiable-by-machine
